title: Baroness Campbell Uses AI Voice for first UK Parliament Speech
summary:
ElevenLabs provided an audio reconstruction that enabled Baroness Campbell of Surbiton to address the House of Lords on Oct 13. The software replicates the original pitch, tone, and rhythm of the Baroness, who has spinal muscular atrophy affecting her speech. According to ElevenLabs, this event marks the first time in the history of the UK Parliament that a recreated voice has been used to deliver a speech.

The company's voice synthesis technology has restored the voices of more than 11,000 people who lost them due to illness or injury. ElevenLabs has committed to expanding its reach to assist 1 million people worldwide living with voice loss.
